# fmt 11.2.0

Upstream: https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/tree/11.2.0

Unmodified `base.h`, `format.h`, and `format-inl.h`, with the upstream LICENSE.
These are the headers needed by this demo's format/print calls. The demo defines
`FMT_HEADER_ONLY` so configuration and compilation require neither network access
nor a separately installed fmt library. UCM allocation sources remain unchanged.
